meta_description:
poojadhingra on October 17, 2026: "Thank you chef @manonfleury__ @thomas.mulhaupt @franceindiafoundation for one of the best and most thoughtful meals I’ve had this year!

@datil.restaurant should definitely be on your Paris list 🫶♥️

It was so incredible to see a team of largely women - and meeting 22-year-old @culinary_curls who is from Hrishikesh and interning at the restaurant! 

Stay tuned for what we’re up to next 👀".
